mapper.insert: INSERT INTO proj_business_result_channel (tenant_id,project_id,owner_context,entity_type,result_type,committed_sequence) VALUES (#{query.tenantId},#{query.projectId},#{query.ownerContext},#{query.entityType},#{query.resultType},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE committed_sequence=committed_sequence
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_business_result_channel WHERE FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM proj_business_result_change WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND channel_id=#{query.channelId} AND source_event_id=#{query.sourceEventId} AND deleted=0

SELECT * FROM proj_business_result_change WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND channel_id=#{query.channelId} AND object_id=#{query.objectId} AND result_id=#{query.resultId} AND formation_marker=1 AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_business_result_channel SET committed_sequence=#{query.nextSequence} WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.channelId} AND committed_sequence=#{query.expectedSequence} AND deleted=0
